definition: double lenses for seeing far-away things
description: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

taps.phrase: to point at a muddy footprint
